population.span: compared the safety and efficacy of ticagrelor vs. clopidogrel in 801 patients with ACS (Japanese, n=721; Taiwanese, n=35; South Korean, n=44; unknown ethnicity, n=1). All were planned to undergo percutaneous coronary intervention and randomized within 24 h of symptom onset.

endpoint.span: Primary safety and efficacy endpoints were time to first occurrence of any major bleeding event

estimate.span: overall major bleeding occurred in 10.3% of ticagrelor-treated patients and in 6.8% of clopidogrel-treated patients (hazard ratio (HR), 1.54; 95% confidence interval (CI): 0.94-2.53)

ci.span: overall major bleeding occurred in 10.3% of ticagrelor-treated patients and in 6.8% of clopidogrel-treated patients (hazard ratio (HR), 1.54; 95% confidence interval (CI): 0.94-2.53)

analysis_set.span: TIME FRAME: Ongoing up to12 months | POPULATION: Safety analysis set which includes all patients who received randomized treatment with available post-treatment safety data

treatment_strategy.span: Safety and Efficacy of AZD6140 on Top of Low Dose Acetyl Salicylic Acid (ASA) Versus Clopidogrel on Top of Low Dose ASA

follow_up.span: At 12 months, overall major bleeding occurred

served_mismatch: Served number (HR 1.54, 0.94-2.53) matches the source for major bleeding. Estimand label inconsistency: served_outcome.estimand is 'RR' while the served row and the source report an HR (Cox model); pooling this HR as an RR would be a scale mismatch.

candidate_rejections.span: RESULT OUTCOME 2 ANALYSIS 0: groups Ticagrelor (AZD6140), Clopidogrel | Hazard Ratio (HR) 1.72 (95% CI 1.23 to 2.40)
candidate_rejections.why: Major-or-minor bleeding composite, not major bleeding.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Randomised patients with non-ST or ST elevation ACS planned for PCI, which falls within adults with ACS; the population is restricted to Japan, Taiwan and South Korea.
entry_population_matches_question.span: The multicenter, double-blind, randomized PHILO trial compared the safety and efficacy of ticagrelor vs. clopidogrel in 801 patients with ACS

notes: PHILO. Registry OUTCOME 0 ANALYSIS 0 confirms 'Hazard Ratio (HR) 1.54 (95% CI 0.94 to 2.53)' in the safety analysis set (387 ticagrelor, 380 clopidogrel). Registry doses: ticagrelor 90 mg bid, clopidogrel 75 mg od, on low-dose ASA. Registry KM 1-year rates (11.2% vs 8.4%) differ from the abstract's crude percentages (10.3% vs 6.8%); the HR is the same in both. Europepmc_core abstract is identical to records.json. The analysis_set span occurs twice in the registry: under OUTCOME 0 (major bleeding) and OUTCOME 2 (major or minor bleeding). Both use the same safety analysis set; the one that applies here is OUTCOME 0.
